{{Disambig|Grave}}

==Consumables==
*[[Graveyard (Consumable)|Graveyard]], a [[PVP]] consumable which summons in [[Normal]]s.

==Enemies==
'''Grave''' may refer to these enemies:
*[[Grave Digger]], a boss enemy that appears as the final boss on Wave 30 in [[Casual Mode|Casual]] mode and on Wave 35 in [[Challenge Trials]].
*[[Grave Digger (Legacy)]], a boss enemy that appeared on Wave 36 in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode and can now be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode if the player has the Sandbox Plus+ [[Gamepasses|gamepass]].
*[[Void Keeper]], internally named '''Void Grave Digger''', a mini-boss enemy that appears on Wave 36 in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode and on Wave 35 in [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode.

It can also refer to these event enemies:
*[[Gravestone]], an immobile enemy that spawns either a [[Giant Skeleton]], [[Hallow Guard (Null & Void)]] or [[Executioner Skeleton (Null & Void)]] on death.

It can also refer to these removed enemies:
*[[Gravekeeper]], a boss enemy that can summon [[Tombstone]]s and stun towers, first appearing in Wave 35 of the [[Pre-MEGA Modes|Pre-MEGA]] modes.
